scope: Investigate the first fatal LAYER boundary in the generated opt-in default-plotstyle AC1024 drawing. The experiments do not establish complete LAYER decoding, material semantics, or AC1024 interoperability.

controls.method: Created an isolated git archive of production writer 5a2ba92e (plus documentation-only successor f34cb683), built its opt-in test, and changed only the test-copy code. TU-terminator change affects all nonempty TU writes in the copy, not just LAYER; material change forces typed hard-pointer null only for null layer material values. Four generated AC1024 files were submitted to ODA File Converter 27.1.0 for DXF conversion. No candidate or generated DWG is committed.

controls.field_check: LibreDWG decoded original LAYER material as (0,0,0) and typed-null candidate as (5,0,0), keeping other decoded LAYER fields unchanged. Source Global is a nonzero pointer, not a typed null.
controls.interpretation: Changing material-null role moves the first fatal boundary under both string variants but does not eliminate the LAYER warning or establish a valid material graph. The TU experiment does not isolate layer-only strings and establishes no global TU encoding rule. ODA process exit status alone is not evidence of success; inspect output and error files.

remaining_work: Characterize independently produced AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032 material graphs and physical object field spans, including the exact complete Global payload, per-version class metadata, reactors, names, ownership and dictionary roles. Search for authentic typed-null LAYER material before interpreting such a value as supported.

Design an explicit early graph admission before class freeze, preserving legacy defaults and caller-provided material/NOD objects. Reserve identities transactionally; reject collisions, conflicting late registrations and malformed ownership without data loss; bind only synthesized or explicitly selected layers.

Implement only source-backed MATERIAL defaults and complete NOD to dictionary to material ownership/reactor and LAYER pointer graph, or fail closed. Verify all three observed defaults rather than assuming Global alone suffices; respect source/caller overrides, class counts, rollback and same-facade retry.

Compare physical field and handle spans with independent readers and source records; require ODA DXF output plus semantic readback and no recovery warnings. Diagnose preceding BLOCK, control, DICTIONARY, STYLE and VPORT warnings independently; the moved fatal boundary is not success.
